source.attribution: Source-qualified temporal-core adaptation of authors' MixerCSeg TransMixer; grouped selective recurrence and v0 initialization follow cited VMamba/Mamba lineage in official source. Mathematical reference only, no claim of vendor-kernel efficiency/equivalence or full crack architecture reproduction.

keep: input-conditioned low-rank delta, shared-per-group B/C, negative exp(A_logs), D skip
source v0 A_logs=log(1..state), D=1, random dt projection with inverse-softplus log-uniform dt bias
zero-initialized selective scan state on every window call
positive softplus(delta+bias) sorted descending on channel dimension for EACH sample/token
rank-ordered gather of global/local channels, both distinct modules, exact scatter to source channel positions
GroupNorm plus local maxpool/sigmoid gate and pointwise projection
scan direction merge after routing, output normalization and SiLU z gate
TransMixer pre-LN residual and GELU MLP
replace: four-direction 2D scan -> two explicitly forward/reverse temporal scans
2D depthwise convolution, local pooling/pointwise conv -> explicit Conv1d/MaxPool1d equivalents
image stem/four-stage hierarchy -> flat ordered six-axis token projection and declared draft stack
HOG/DEG, SRF and segmentation decoder omitted; not a full MixerCSeg baseline
pixel classifier/BCE-Dice -> final normalization, temporal mean and one linear XYZ head/plain MSE
custom selective CUDA kernels -> pure PyTorch source mathematical recurrence
in-place source advanced-index writes -> functional gather/scatter for autograd
source fused attention always-nonzero dropout_p -> standard nn.Dropout disabled in eval

explicit_semantic_changes.dtype: source reference forces float32; port uses float32 normally, preserves float64 for scientific verification and returns original input dtype
explicit_semantic_changes.eval_dropout: deterministic eval fix; source fused path ignores training mode for attn_drop.p; adapter default dropout=0 has identical dropout semantics
explicit_semantic_changes.scatter: functional exact full-partition scatter, intended value/gradient equivalence pending tests
explicit_semantic_changes.scan_count: 2 vs original 4; temporal-core adaptation, never full 2D VSS equivalence
explicit_semantic_changes.tie_policy: source default torch.sort semantics; no promise of tie-order invariant channel meaning
explicit_semantic_changes.discrete_selection_gradient: no surrogate gradient through sort indices; delta still differentiates through recurrence, as source hard ranking

declared_recipe_choices.initialization: source v0 specialized dt/A/D; remaining PyTorch layer defaults, not source full segmentation training reproduction
declared_recipe_choices.width_depth_status: adapter hypothesis only; no parameter/MAC/accuracy/capacity admission measured

identity.complexity: only selective recurrence is linear in tokens; global attention is quadratic; no source CUDA efficiency claim
identity.geometry_boundary: latent channel routing and physics-inspired image features do not confer verified inertial physical/geometric meaning

scientific_contract.input_track: reference_oracle; same privileges as controls, not deployable orientation inference
scientific_contract.output: vel: B,3 real supervised XYZ window-average velocity (m/s), no zero-filled Z
scientific_contract.head: temporal mean -> one Linear(d_model,3)
scientific_contract.loss: plain common supervised MSE only, no HOG/BCE/Dice/auxiliary loss
scientific_contract.temporal_scope: window_noncausal; no outside-window inputs, target access in forward, test fitting or cross-window state
